summary: Tempest Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting that its July 27, 2026 special meeting of stockholders was adjourned due to insufficient votes to approve a charter amendment replacing supermajority voting requirements and permitting written consent. The meeting reconvenes August 17, 2026; record date remains May 28, 2026. The proposal requires 75% affirmative vote. This is a routine procedural adjournment, not a special-situation event. No deal terms are present.
